refactor(camellia): align remaining route families

Summary:
- move the remaining system, locale, i18n, dictionary, user, and
  content detail routes onto shared Card and Table surfaces
- replace route-local rounded and shadow shells in app, endpoint,
  oss, node, role, notification, and feedback detail views
- normalize the last content editor and size-range pages to the
  preset-driven layout baseline

Rationale:
- keeps the shadcn-ui preset applied consistently across the full
  migrated camellia console instead of stopping at high-traffic pages
- removes the last obvious route-local visual forks before review,
  which keeps future preset additions route-agnostic

Tests:
- pnpm --dir bougainvillea run check:camellia
- PORT=3218 pnpm --dir bougainvillea --filter @bougainvillea/camellia start
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3218/system/node
- curl -I http://127.0.0.1:3218/system/role
